name: @cb/creator-worker
description: Agent Package native Codex Session、Project Context Compiler 与 Creator Worker

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -b && esbuild dist/agent-package-creator-bridge.js --bundle --packages=bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --charset=utf8 --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/agent-package-creator-bridge.mjs
scripts.pretest: pnpm -F @cb/creator-agent-protocol build && pnpm -F @cb/creator-agent-persistence build && pnpm -F @cb/creator-agent-broker-journal build && pnpm -F @cb/creator-worker-broker-client build && pnpm run build
scripts.experience: pnpm -F @cb/creator-agent-persistence build && tsc -b && node dist/agent-catalog-cli.js experience
scripts.test:real-agent: pnpm run pretest && COMBO_REAL_CODEX_E2E=1 vitest run src/__tests__/agent-local-runner.real.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:real-context-compiler: pnpm run pretest && COMBO_REAL_CODEX_E2E=1 vitest run src/__tests__/project-context-compiler.real.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:real-package: pnpm run pretest && COMBO_REAL_CODEX_E2E=1 vitest run src/__tests__/agent-package-session.real.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:real-package-authoring: pnpm run pretest && COMBO_REAL_CODEX_E2E=1 vitest run src/__tests__/agent-package-authoring.real.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:real-package-creator-bridge: pnpm run pretest && COMBO_REAL_CODEX_E2E=1 vitest run src/__tests__/agent-package-creator-bridge.real.test.ts --reporter=verbose
